featured_reviews.name: Omkar Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had booked Ceremonial Catering food service for my engagement and I can say it was the best decision. Everything was perfect.

Everyone that we have met have just talked good about our engagement food. Since my engagement was in August, we had the option for seasonal Sitafal basundi and the taste was heavenly. They also have a variety of options for starters and fast food option. We had selected Cheese balls and Shikampuri as starters and had fast food counters for Pani puri which everyone just loved. We also had a Dosa counter which had four different kinds of Dosa like Sada dosa, Masala Dosa, Schezwan Dosa and Cheese dosa.

We had also visited their kitchen and I must say that it was really really clean and hygienic. Highly recommended if you are looking for a great end-to-end catering solution.

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
7 stars for Ceremonial catering service we took at Govindmani event for 9th Nov wedding reception of my elder daughter.

This was the third time over years we have used ceremonial service within our family wedding. The service was just perfect with personal attention from management, especially Abhishek. The food was just too good and we got lot of amazing feedback from our guests. Every item was well done. All Items were specially mentioned - chicken rara, blue rice, the starters, welcome drinks, pasta, ice creams, cham cham and the list goes on ...

The display sets used for the counters were specifically recommended by ceremonial mgmt and went so well with our overall theme.

For our family, every wedding we have done with ceremonial, it is getting better and better:) Looking forward to next one.
